(97)gu ru'i sgrub pa byin brlabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/āḥgazhi las tha mal 'jin pa bral ba la sa/zung

tei:div.tei:p: gu ru'i sgrub pa byin brlabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ āḥ gzhi las tha mal 'jin pa bral ba la sa/ zung 'jug rig pa gzhi rjogs ye shes nyid/ tha mal nyams kyi 'jin ltangs zhig pa las/ rig 'jin gtso mchog rdo rje thod phreng rtsal/ mthing nag brjid pa zhi ma khro yi nyams/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje phur pa 'jin/ rnal 'byor stag shams rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ dbu skra thor tshugs dar dpyangs rin chen mjad/ yum mchog mtsho rgyal dmar mo gri thod 'jin/ gcer bu skra khros rin chen rus pas brgyan/ spyi gtsug phag zhal nag mo ngur sgra sgrogs/ me tog man+da ra ba'i chun po 'chang*/ bde chen nyams kyi lang tsho 'bar ba'i sku/ thabs mchog yab kyi sku la gnyis med 'khril/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi dang khro bo dang*/ gnas yul dur khrod ma sring mkha' 'gro bcas/ snang la rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid/ (98)gsal la der 'jin bral ba ye shes rtsal/ snang stong sgyu ma 'ja' yi tshul du gsal/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ḥ dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ rig 'jin gtso mchog rdau rje thod phreng rtsal/ 'khor du rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bcas/ bsgrub mchog bdag la byin brlabs dbang skur phyir/ gnas mchog nyams dga' 'di ru gshegs su gsol/ sgrub mchog bdag la dgongs te gshegs su gsol/ bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ skal ldan mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur/ rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs/ ye nas rang dang 'du 'bral med pa yi/ gnyis su med pa ye shes chen po'i ngang*/ chos nyid mnyam pa chen por bzhugs nas kyang*/ bdag la dus 'di nas bzungs byang chub bar/ thugs rjes dgongs la byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ gu ru rin po che gsal ba'i thugs rin po che mchong gur phub pa lta bu'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing ka'i

(99) mtha' bskor du rdo rje'i tshig gi phreng ba rnams lu gu rgyud bar ma chad par kyi li li 'khor ba'i 'od dang sgra dang zer las rgyal ba thams cad dang khyad par du gu ru mtsha skyes rdo rje'i thugs rgyud bskul/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ga'i rnam pa bdag la thim par bsam la/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags/ 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis/ byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pas 'jab kyi tshul du bzla'o/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas snang srid dag sbyangs ste/ snod bcud thams cad mer mer khyom khyom shig shig tu 'gul bas lha klu bdud btsan ma mo sogs ye shes dang 'jig rten pa'i dregs pa gter gyi srung ma thams cad dang*/ rin pa che sa yi gter thams cad gnas nas 'gul te gu ru rin po che'i gsang ba gsum du bzhengs nas bdag la thim par bsgom la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs kho na la brtson pa'o/ āḥ gnas dang snang ba thams (100)cad kun/ ye nas ye shes rol pa'i ngang*/ zang thal rig pa rjen pa'i klong*/ blo 'das chos sku'i rang zhal blta/ āḥ zhes dgongs pa'i rgyun bskyangs so/ ces pa'ang bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos bskul ngor sngags btsun mas 'brel rtsal gyis blo mchod dwangs pa las byung ba dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ ༈ gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ 'pho 'gyur spros pa'i tshogs kyis yongs dben kyang*/ gdul bya'i 'gro ngor skye 'jig tshul ston pa/ dpal ldan yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma rje/ mi shigs rtag pa dam pa'i ngo bo ru/ bskal mang rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed ji srid du/ zhabs pad brtan zhing yun ring 'tsho gzhes gsol/ bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthu/

sras bcas rgyal ba'i bden pa mi bslu bas/ smon pa 'di dag yongs su 'grub pa yi/ gegs med yid bzhin 'char ba'i dge mtshan gyis/ sa gsum bkra shis snang bas khyab par shog bla ma bde chen bskul ngor bris pa dge'o/// /
